scope: Control Center light and dark command lookup

checks.detail: Loaded the release ControlCommands.qml with QQmlComponent and invoked run(dark), run(light), run(dark). An executable recording its single argument was found first with a space-containing temporary HOME and PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin, then with only a PATH installation.

coverage_limits: Command dispatch only. The check used a recording executable and did not switch a live desktop.
